title: HMAC max-buf overrun: WC_HW_E with no diagnostic
description: crypto2dev_hmac():L1052-1053 returns WC_HW_E with no WOLFSSL_MSG when accumulated HMAC input exceeds WOLFSSL_CRYPTO2DEV_HMAC_MAX_BUF. The caller sees WC_HW_E from wc_HmacUpdate with no indication of cause. This will generate recurring support questions ('HMAC returns hardware error for large inputs'). The explanation of why CRYPTOCB_UNAVAILABLE is unsafe is in the header and .c but not in the error path. A WOLFSSL_MSG('crypto2dev: HMAC input exceeds WOLFSSL_CRYPTO2DEV_HMAC_MAX_BUF — hard failure, cannot fall back') would make the failure self-diagnosing.
